maya_cs: Quick thread: prepping QBR for Helios (renewal in 6 weeks). Rolling up spend + onboarding health. Anyone have latest token run-rate and projection? Also any enablement gaps? cc @leo_finops @sam_onboard

leo_finops: I have a run-rate snapshot. Last 30d avg tokens/day = 4.2M. Projected month burn w/ current growth ~130M tokens -> ~$6.5k/mo at current tier. But we saw spike last week from embed jobs.

sam_onboard: Onboarding: 70% of pilot seats active, docs sent, scheduled trainings 3/28. Main risk: they started parallel POC that uses dedicated embed pipelines (big cost). We flagged it in ticket.

maya_cs: Can you paste the spike timeframe? Need to call it out in the QBR and propose throttling/cost guardrails.

leo_finops: Spike: 2026-02-12 -> +2.1M tokens/day over baseline. Root cause: batch embed job misconfigured (no batching). Ticket #CS-8421.

jin_eng: We can suggest two options: add batching and use quantized model variant. Ops: add rate limit to /embeddings route and a preflight check in SDK. I'll draft a short snippet.

jin_eng: ```json
{ "route": "/embeddings", "rate_limit_qps": 2, "batch_size": 128, "fallback_model": "embed-quant-v2" }
```

maya_cs: Perfect. Let's include recommended cost savings estimate: batching => ~60% cost reduction on that workload. @leo_finops can you calculate projected savings for QBR slide?

leo_finops: I'll run numbers and attach to deck. Quick ask: do we want to propose a one-time credits buffer or production commit? Buffer preferred short-term, but commit needed if they want Dedicated.

sam_onboard: Customer sentiment: willing to accept short-term throttles if communicated. They care about latency for embed ingestion scripts. We need to propose a migration path.

maya_cs: Action items: leo - run savings & two scenarios (buffer vs 6mo commit) by EOD 3/1; jin - draft routing guard + SDK preflight snippet; sam - capture enablement slide + migration checklist. I'll assemble QBR deck. :spiral_calendar:

opsbot: Reminder: QBR deck template, upload to #qbr-decks by 2026-03-02 17:00. Link: https://redwood.app/qbr/templates

maya_cs: Added. Thanks team :thumbsup:
